description.plain:
This putty knife set contains 4 putty knives-3 with flexible blades and 1 with a stiff blade.

The set is ideal for homeowners or DIYers for performing operations, doing drywall taping, sealing drywall joints, applying materials, spackling, scraping, or removing.

Size: 1-1/2", 3", 4", 6"

High Quality: These putty knives are made of stainless steel, ensuring high quality, flexibility, durability, and smoothness

More Robust: Mirror-polished for enhanced durability and rust resistance. Note: After using the putty knife, clean it promptly and keep it dry during storage to ensure the blade's longevity

Safe to Use: The ergonomic handle, made from PP & TPR materials, provides a comfortable and soft grip, and features a finger guide rail for added safety

Multi-Purpose: The set includes 4 sizes of putty knives in both flexible and stiff versions for various applications

Includes: This putty knife set includes four different widths: 1.5", 3", 4", and 6". It meets most of your essential needs with a blade thickness of 1.2 mm

Design

  • All blades are constructed by stainless steel of high quality, robust, tough and smooth; mirror polished for durability and rust resistance
  • Ergonomic handle by PP & TPR material,comfortable and soft grip
  • Finger guide rail in the front and back for better leverage with less effort

Three types of grip:

  • 1. Power grip: strong handhold while scraping
  • 2. Finger guide rail: control pull/push
  • 3. Precision grip: gently and accurately spread and smooth compounds

media.alt_text: Four putty knives with blue and red handles and stainless steel blades

top_features: Four-piece set with three flexible and one stiff blade for various applications

Ergonomic PP TPR handles provide a comfortable, soft grip and finger guide rail for safety
Multiple blade sizes (1.2 mm, 1 in, 3 in, 4 in, 6 in) accommodate different tasks
Power, precision, and control grips for tailored handling
unique_selling_points: Includes three flexible and one stiff stainless steel blade putty knives in four different sizes for maximum versatility.

description.plain:
Kraft 5" One-Piece Sure Grip All-Stainless Putty Knife DW730PF

The Kraft 5" One-Piece Sure Grip All-Stainless Putty Knife DW730PF is the most unique but also the most durable joint knife around: The knife and handle are made out of a single piece of stainless steel. The polished blade is ideal for scraping, painting and drywall applications. Non-rust stainless steel blade and handle is made from one-piece of material for strength and longevity. The end of the handle is flat and strong for nail setting. The rivet-free, contoured handle comfortable and easy to grasp.
Kraft has added a soft rubber sleeve on the one-piece stainless steel model for even more comfort and grip.

 

Kraft 5" One-Piece Sure Grip All-Stainless Putty Knife DW730PF Features:

  • Flexible putty & drywall knife
  • One piece stainless steel blade and handle
  • Blade ground for comfortable "broken-in" feel
  • Neoprene grip sleve is soft, comfortable, and resists slipping from sweat and moisture

DW730PF

Kraft Tool
